_provenance: Clean configuration (2026-11-03), after the organisers' rules clarification: every setting is chosen on external data only (open-data cross-validation), never on the provided match's ground truth or video. Members: tempolens_rnd4_m0..2.pt, trained on the 10 open matches with domain randomisation (python -m tempolens.train --member k --draws 4; CV ensemble 0.7716 vs 0.7636 without). Decoder costs (switch 2, alive>dead 2, dead>alive 2, change bonus 0.5) are the argmax of that CV (experiments --model ensemble --draws 4). Test-time adaptation, EATA and the team-evidence gate are off unless the open-data adaptation study (tempolens.adaptcv) supports them.
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py). Off: on the real match the tags agree with a confident model 83% (attacking codes) and 94% (defensive codes) of the time, yet the prior lowered the public-window spellF1 (0.43 vs 0.59, single GRU).
